habit.description: After blocking a projectile the Oni dashes straight in. Throw a second projectile or meet the dash with a throw or anti-air before it arrives.

notes: Oni aggressive (Y2): dashes in constantly; habit 70% unchanged. YOK-174 strikes: heavy club (oni-heavy-punch 16f startup, readable tell) at close range, medium punch and light punch as the fast pressure, medium kick as a mid-range poke after the dash-in, medium punch against a blocking opponent as a frame trap (8f, recovery 7). Throw cut from 35 to 15 so strikes dominate. Single attacking answer to opponent_jumping stays oni-medium-punch (YOK-165). Iron-Club Charge not wired (no special in data/moves). Kappa untouched.
